name: wan2.7-i2v
description: Wan2.7-I2V is an image-to-video generation model that animates static images while preserving original structure, color style, composition, and visual details. Supports 720P and 1080P, video duration 2-15 seconds.
zhDescription: Wan2.7-I2V是图像到视频生成模型，可将静态图像动画化，同时保持原始结构、色彩风格、构图和视觉细节。支持720P和1080P，视频时长2-15秒。
longDescription: Wan2.7-I2V is an image-to-video generation model that animates static images while preserving original structure, color style, composition, and visual details. Supports 720P and 1080P, video duration 2-15 seconds.

modelParameters.label: Top P

modelParameters.label: Max Tokens
modelParameters.description: 单次生成的最大 token 数量

modelParameters.label: Frequency Penalty
modelParameters.description: 频率惩罚，减少重复内容的生成

modelParameters.label: Context Length
